integrity: Exact quotient-chain and signed Burnside calculations are fully reconstructed by the bundled standalone verifier; the homotopy upgrade invokes published shellability, Armstrong, Hurewicz, and Whitehead theorems.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary S_n geometric orbit spaces for n=2,3,4,5 are classified. No assertion for n>5, no equivariant or Borel classification, and no independent audit. Public priority cannot be established exhaustively from indexed searches.
title: First branching in symmetric quotients of complete directed-forest complexes
